text: The team outlined designing the LCD screen function menu and preparing a list of functions to display.
The UI designer will group the menu into a display group and a basic functions group, while ID will design the LCD layout.

Decisions include skipping Teletext, defining an age range of sixteen to forty, creating two function groups (simple for the public and advanced for younger users), activating the LCD/TV options menu by software, and placing the screen at the top with extra advanced options on onscreen display.
The Project Manager will reorganize project materials after this meeting, and there remains uncertainty about which functions to include.
There is a concern that elderly users may not understand the remote, indicating a need for a simpler remote design.
